item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: HTTP header insertion in Azure Firewall
item.description:
Azure Firewall now supports inserting or overwriting HTTP/HTTPS request headers from application rules. This lets organizations enforce security controls and support tenant restriction at the firewall layer.

  • Source: Azure Updates
